     MEET YOUR BIRTHDAY FRIEND

    A little catching magic

    1. Swipe up from the ball.Aim toward PartyPoss. A small green ring earns a better throw. You can also tap the ball.
    2. Sweeten the encounter.A berry boosts your next hit. Ultra Balls give you a better chance. Regular balls never run out.
    3. Try Maui Wali.Tap the move to see PartyPoss cast his swirl of leaves, flowers, and birthday confetti.

    Keyboard: Space to throw · B for a berry · U to switch balls · M for Maui Wali.

    Use AR for a live camera background, or the camera icon to save a photo. Camera mode needs your permission.
